title: Fix client profile save loop (persist client profile updates instead of refreshing)

requirements.text: Fix the client profile “Save Required Information” action so it updates an existing client profile instead of calling the backend method intended only for initial profile creation, and ensure the save action does not trigger a full page reload/refresh.

quotes: When i save the data in the profile in the client's section its not saving its keeps on refreshing the page without saving it. kindly resolve

acceptanceCriteria: From the Client Profile page, clicking “Save Required Information” does not reload the browser page.

If the user already has a client profile, saving required fields updates the stored profile successfully (surname, middleName, lastName, yearOfBirth, idNumber, mobileNumber/phoneNumber, pinnedLocation).
After saving, reloading the app and revisiting the Client Profile page shows the newly saved values populated from the backend.
If saving fails due to validation/authorization, the UI shows a clear error message and does not reload the page.

requirements.text: Add a dedicated backend update method for client required profile fields (names, yearOfBirth, idNumber, mobileNumber/phoneNumber, pinnedLocation) that validates input and updates the caller’s existing client profile record without requiring profile re-creation.

quotes: When i save the data in the profile in the client's section its not saving its keeps on refreshing the page without saving it. kindly resolve

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a new shared method to update the caller’s existing client profile required fields without trapping with “Profile already exists…”.
The update method enforces the same validation rules currently applied for client profiles (non-empty fields and pinnedLocation required with non-zero coordinates/address).
The update method traps with a clear message if the caller is not authenticated, is not a client, or has no existing client profile.

requirements.text: Update the frontend Client Profile page to use the new client-profile update mutation for saving required fields, and ensure React Query cache invalidation/refetch updates the UI state without navigation loops.

quotes: its not saving its keeps on refreshing the page without saving it

acceptanceCriteria: ClientProfilePage no longer calls the initial profile-creation mutation to save required fields.
On successful save, the current user profile query is invalidated and the updated profile is shown (either immediately or after refetch) without the page appearing to refresh repeatedly.
The Save button shows a loading state while the mutation is pending and is re-enabled afterward.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Redesigning the client profile UI beyond what is required to fix saving and refresh behavior.
Changing authentication flows or Internet Identity integration.
